name: context-manager-skill
description: Saves a handoff before context compaction, checks planned work against the context budget, offers the right next step (compact, continue in a fresh session, raise this session's limit, use subagents) with your usage limits in mind, guards stale resumes, warns on large reads and shows a live context meter. Per-project or global settings. Windows, macOS and Linux.

prep_at.title: Prepare handoff at (tokens)
prep_at.description: Context size at which Claude writes a compaction handoff. A project's .claude/context-manager.json overrides this.

compact_at.title: Compact at (tokens)
compact_at.description: Compaction runs once context reaches this size and the handoff is saved; it is held below it.

force_at.title: Safety limit (tokens)
force_at.description: Above this size compaction always runs, handoff or not.

auto_compact.title: Compact automatically
auto_compact.description: Compact on its own after the turn where context reaches the compaction threshold with a saved handoff. Off: you type /compact.

show_meter.title: Show context meter
show_meter.description: Show context size and handoff state above the prompt (terminal and desktop app).

offer_options.title: Offer options
offer_options.description: After a handoff, and when planned work may not fit, show the options picker (buttons above the prompt, or a question in VS Code).

preflight_check.title: Check planned work
preflight_check.description: When Claude plans a set of tasks, have it check they fit before compaction and offer options if not.

usage_aware.title: Mind my usage limits
usage_aware.description: When your 5-hour or weekly limit is getting full, recommend the option that uses less first and show the limit in the meter.

limit_pressure_at.title: Usage limit warning point (%)
limit_pressure_at.description: How full a usage limit gets before cheaper options are recommended first.

stale_guard.title: Offer a fresh start on stale resumes
stale_guard.description: When you reopen a large session whose cache has expired, offer to continue in a fresh session instead of re-sending everything.

check_handoff_quality.title: Check handoff quality
check_handoff_quality.description: A handoff only counts as saved once its Goal, Current status and Next steps sections have content.

check_updates.title: Check for updates
check_updates.description: Check GitHub at most twice a day and say when a newer version is available.

track_stats.title: Keep project stats
track_stats.description: Count sessions, handoffs, compactions and large reads per project, shown in /context-manager.

warn_large_reads.title: Warn on large tool results (tokens)
warn_large_reads.description: Show a notice when one tool result adds at least this many tokens of context. 0 turns it off.
